_comment: Ground-truth labelled emails. 'expected' is the human label we compare the classifier against when computing accuracy. Later phases will add more rows here; a regression means accuracy on THESE rows dropped.

emails.subject: Charged twice this month
emails.body: Hi, I was charged twice for my subscription this month and I would like a refund for the duplicate invoice. My card ending 4412 shows two identical charges.

emails.subject: API returns 500
emails.body: Your API started returning error 500 on every request since yesterday morning. The server is either down or the endpoint is broken. Requests time out after 30 seconds.

emails.subject: Locked out after 2FA reset
emails.body: I am locked out of my account after trying to reset my password and set up 2FA. I cannot sign in and the password reset email never arrives.

emails.subject: Feedback on new docs
emails.body: Just wanted to say the new documentation site is clear and easy to navigate. No problem to report, this is general feedback and a small feature request.

emails.subject: Update payment method
emails.body: Can you tell me where to update my payment method? My receipt shows the old card and I want to change it before the next invoice.

emails.subject: Dashboard very slow
emails.body: The analytics dashboard is extremely slow since the last release and sometimes fails to load entirely. Is this a known bug?

emails.subject: Suspended account appeal
emails.body: My account was suspended for no clear reason. Please review and restore it, I need permission to my workspace files.

emails.subject: Opening hours
emails.body: Do you have an office I can visit? Sharing a bit of context about our team and what we are hoping to build next.
